content: Job/role mapping compares positions across both orgs to find overlaps/gaps/redundancies and builds the merged job architecture -- start this early and iteratively (reduces retention + productivity risk); common pattern is a 'stabilization' org design for initial integration then a later synergy/transformation redesign pass. Acquired employees are ~2x more likely to leave than direct hires; studied tech-company attrition roughly doubled post-close (32-36% -> 55-71% over following 2 years), with leadership-layer attrition most damaging. Flight-risk scoring should use existing HR data (comp vs market, performance rating, succession/critical-role flag, tenure) without new invasive data collection. Redundancy best practice: have the 1:1 conversation with an affected individual within one week of the decision to avoid rumor-driven additional attrition.
